name: Anna Słonecka (z Słończyc)

events.type: Consented to the conveyance of Trąbczyn
Held Trąbczyn for life as widow
events.note: Stanisław's widow, lady of his estates by dower and life interest ("Dominam Reformatoriam et Advitalem"), holding them with her sons.

events.type: Widow with a life interest in the estates; cited with her sons

notes: Daughter of Jan Słonecki and Elżbieta Chwalibowska (the regest of 1614).
